operators.name: mean_dim
semantics: Corresponds to torch.mean(x, dim) where dim is an int scalar (value 1 for this task).
Reduces input tensor of shape [B, C, H, W] along dimension C (specified by dim tensor scalar).
Output tensor has shape [B, H, W] with dtype float32.
The mean is computed as sum over the specified dimension divided by C.

operators.name: gelu
semantics: Corresponds to F.gelu(x) with default approximate='none'.
Element-wise GELU activation: 0.5 * x * (1 + erf(x / sqrt(2))).
Input and output shapes are identical.
Reduces input tensor of shape [16, 1024, 512, 256] along dimension 1 (self.input_size=1).
Mean reduction: sum over dim=1 divided by 1024.
Applies element-wise GELU activation to the mean output.
No change in shape or dtype.
Returns the final GELU-activated tensor of shape [16, 512, 256].
